verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of mapping data between steps or transforming it with expressions, functions, or formulas. The only nearby mention is that flow actions can include "running code" (activepieces-docs-39). It does not say that code steps can reference earlier step outputs or transform data, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can map and transform data between steps with expressions, functions, or formulas
